run_check_bias_on_model: run check_bias on a pretrained VGG or ResNet model to analyze BatchNorm2d layer bias distributions
check_batchnorm_bias_distribution: check the positive and negative bias distribution across all BatchNorm2d layers in a PyTorch model
analyze_pretrained_model_biases: analyze bias statistics of pretrained torchvision models like vgg16_bn or resnet50
review_check_bias_function: review the check_bias function that inspects BatchNorm2d bias values and prints positive vs negative percentages
refactor_check_bias_for_custom_models: refactor check_bias to accept a custom PyTorch model and report BatchNorm2d bias distribution statistics
